decisions.reason: As a newly launched compliance-related tool that fits the firm’s announced expansion of agency-focused and compliance capabilities, has its own page, and already shows a positive agency reaction, management would likely continue it rather than reverse course quickly.

Because this platform is highly central to the core hosting business, was visible on the home page, and represents a public strategic commitment to agency-oriented platform expansion, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although less visibly strategic than the platform and compliance software, this managed hosting plan is close to the firm’s established offer, uses existing infrastructure and service capabilities, and disappointing early uptake could readily be blamed on temporary market or rollout factors.
